cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434001:.text: Marked sinner! Get out of here!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434001:.source_cn: 有印记的罪人！快滚出来！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434003:.source_cn: 贝丝薇快不行了……求你们

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434004:.text: This is the price of breaking the law!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410434004:.source_cn: 这就是触犯律法的代价！

say:5:1410435001:0.text: Glory to the Queen! Captain, this commoner with the Stigma tried to sneak into the line, but I caught him!
say:5:1410435001:0.source_cn: 女王荣光永存！报告卫队长！这名带印记的平民妄图混入队伍...

say:8:1410435002:1.text: It's not for me... it's for Bethwyn! She's too weak...
say:8:1410435002:1.source_cn: 我不是为了自己，是贝丝薇。贝丝薇太虚弱了。她快要……

say:9:1410435003:1.source_cn: 求求你们了，各位卫兵大人们！给贝丝薇一点怜悯吧！

say:10:1410435004:0.text: If she wants Divine Dew, she can come get it herself. The law forbids collecting it for others.
say:10:1410435004:0.source_cn: 让她自己来取，律法有言，不得代领！

say:11:1410435005:1.text: She... she can't. She has the Stigma too, she—

say:12:1410435006:0.text: Hmph! Then there's nothing more to say! Do you think the priests punish the innocent or the guilty?
say:12:1410435006:0.source_cn: 哼！那还有什么好说的！祭司大人们难道会平白无故地惩罚无...

say:14:1410435007:0.source_cn: 给她一点慈悲吧，卫兵大人！

say:15:1410435008:1.text: Vexa... Thank you, but I already know how this ends...
say:15:1410435008:1.source_cn: 维克莎，多谢你。我已经知道该怎么做了……

say:16:1410435009:0.text: That's right, commoner. Better to give up now.
say:16:1410435009:0.source_cn: 没错，平民。早点死心为好。

say:17:1410435010:0.text: Oh, and by the way, report her location later. We'll handle the cleanup.
say:17:1410435010:0.source_cn: 对了，待会记得上报她的位置，我们会负责清理。

say:18:1410435011:0.text: No! Bethwyn's still herself! She can hold on. I have to go... She needs me!
say:18:1410435011:0.source_cn: 不，贝丝薇还好。她还能坚持……我先走了！她现在很需要我！

say:23:1410435013:0.text: It's getting late. You can end your shift now.
say:23:1410435013:0.source_cn: 你，时候不早了，准备交接吧。

say:24:1410435014:0.text: Captain, shouldn't we keep an eye on that kid? Just in case...
say:24:1410435014:0.source_cn: 卫队长，我们真的不用去盯着那小子吗？以防万一……

say:25:1410435015:0.text: ...I'll take care of it. Go rest.
say:25:1410435015:0.source_cn: ……无事，我稍后再安排。你早点回去休息。

say:26:1410435016:0.text: Yes, sir! Glory to the Queen!

say:28:1410435017:0.text: Everyone, form a proper line! No pushing. You will all get your share.
say:28:1410435017:0.source_cn: 都排好队，一个一个来领取！

say:31:1410435018:0.text: It's Indris! Everyone, let's line up properly.
say:31:1410435018:0.source_cn: 是因度厄！大家该排队的好好排队……

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.text: That person in line... they're marked too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.source_cn: 那个排队的人……好像也有印记
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.male: That person in line... they're marked too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436001:.female: That person in line... they're marked too.

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436002:.text: Order must be maintained! Step forward one at a time!
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436002:.source_cn: 保持秩序！大家都能分到

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.text: Indris... what kind of person are you?
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.source_cn: 因度厄，你到底是什么样的人？
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.male: Indris... what kind of person are you?
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436003:.female: Indris... what kind of person are you?

cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436004:.text: ...Perhaps I should try to get some too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436004:.male: ...Perhaps I should try to get some too.
cinematic_dialogue:35:1410436004:.female: ...Perhaps I should try to get some too.

narration:36:1410437001:0.text: You step into line with the other commoners to receive the Divine Dew. Indris, despite clearly seeing the Stigma of Judgment upon you, chooses to ignore it. Without resistance, the dew is placed in your hands.
narration:36:1410437001:0.source_cn: 你跟随着其他平民排队领取恩典灵露，因度厄似乎对你不加掩...

narration:37:1410437002:0.text: You examine the Divine Dew, sensing the faint magic within. Although the magic is weak, with enough time, it really can keep the corruption at bay.
narration:37:1410437002:0.source_cn: 你探查这份灵露，发现其中蕴含了特殊的魔力……虽然含量很...

narration:38:1410437003:0.text: As you observe the line, you notice something—other marked commoners are receiving the dew as well. Indris, watching over the process, seems to be allowing this.
narration:38:1410437003:0.source_cn: 随后你仔细观察着队伍，同样有一些身负惩罚印记的平民获取...

say:44:1410439001:0.text: Don't hurt him! He's not like the others!
say:44:1410439001:0.source_cn: 不要伤害凯登！他是个好孩子！

say:45:1410439002:0.text: Stay where you are! He's already transformed! If you get too close—
say:45:1410439002:0.source_cn: 别过来！他已经孽化了！为了你们的安全——

say:46:1410439003:1.text: This is your fault! First Bethwyn, now Caiden!
say:46:1410439003:1.source_cn: 都是你们的错！是你们害的！先是贝丝薇，又是凯登！

say:47:1410439004:1.text: You're holding a weapon. Are you planning to cut him down like the others?!
say:47:1410439004:1.source_cn: 你拿着武器，要做什么？是不是要斩下他们的头颅！

say:51:1410439006:1.text: We've given everything to Sal'thorin! Our blood, our lives... only to be cast aside the moment we stumble!
say:51:1410439006:1.source_cn: 我们为萨洛克兰付出了很多！不……我们付出了一切！然而这...

say:52:1410439007:0.text: Ceron's right! The nobles hoard knowledge and resources. We fight and struggle, hoping to climb higher, only to be crushed for the slightest mistake!
say:52:1410439007:0.source_cn: 索伦说的没错！知识和资源被贵族们垄断，我们拼尽全力爬到...

say:53:1410439008:0.text: Generation after generation, we live in fear of corruption, trapped in a cycle we can never break! Is this our destiny?
say:53:1410439008:0.source_cn: 世世代代重复着所谓的命运，时时刻刻面临着孽化产生的风险...

say:54:1410439009:0.text: I understand your pain. I was one of you once... I know how it feels.
say:54:1410439009:0.source_cn: 诸位，我了解你们的痛苦。我也同样是平民出身……

say:55:1410439010:0.text: But right now, we have to stop the spread of corruption. Please, step aside!
say:55:1410439010:0.source_cn: 但现在最重要的是阻止孽化蔓延，请让开！

say:56:1410439011:0.text: Enough! How long are we supposed to endure this?!
say:56:1410439011:0.source_cn: 我受够了！我们凭什么要承受这些？

say:58:1410439012:1.text: Caiden's fate today is ours tomorrow! Don't let them take him! We won't let these so-called guards execute another one of our own!
say:58:1410439012:1.source_cn: 凯登的今日就是我们的明天！拦住他们，不能再让这些刽子手...

narration:60:14010433:0.text: While you're lining up for Divine Dew, Caiden sneaks into the queue again. But before long, he starts to turn, causing panic.
narration:60:14010433:0.source_cn: 你在排队领取灵露时，凯登再次混入了队伍。但他在此过程中...
narration:60:14010433:0.male: While you're lining up for Divine Dew, Caiden sneaks into the queue again. But before long, he starts to turn, causing panic.
narration:60:14010433:0.female: While you're lining up for Divine Dew, Caiden sneaks into the queue again. But before long, he starts to turn, causing panic.

narration:61:14010432:0.text: A commoner, bearing the Stigma of Judgment, seeks to blend into the line. Indris offers no reaction. Intrigued by his indifference, you take your place in the queue, waiting to see his response.
narration:61:14010432:0.source_cn: 身有惩罚印记的平民尝试排在队伍中，但因度厄毫无反应。于...
narration:61:14010432:0.male: A commoner, bearing the Stigma of Judgment, seeks to blend into the line. Indris offers no reaction. Intrigued by his indifference, you take your place in the queue, waiting to see his response.
narration:61:14010432:0.female: A commoner, bearing the Stigma of Judgment, seeks to blend into the line. Indris offers no reaction. Intrigued by his indifference, you take your place in the queue, waiting to see his response.

narration:62:14010431:0.text: The crowd gathers, eager for a taste of Divine Dew. At the back of the line, Caiden stands, a quiet figure among them. As the guards advance to remove him, Indris appears.
narration:62:14010431:0.source_cn: 众人排队领取恩典灵露，而队尾的凯登被发现了。卫兵们驱逐...
narration:62:14010431:0.male: The crowd gathers, eager for a taste of Divine Dew. At the back of the line, Caiden stands, a quiet figure among them. As the guards advance to remove him, Indris appears.
narration:62:14010431:0.female: The crowd gathers, eager for a taste of Divine Dew. At the back of the line, Caiden stands, a quiet figure among them. As the guards advance to remove him, Indris appears.
